researchResults.title: OMRON to acquire OnLogic to address edge AI applications
researchResults.description:
OMRON will add industrial computing from OnLogic to its industrial automation expertise to serve data- and AI-intensive applications.

The post OMRON to acquire OnLogic to address edge AI applications appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Bedrock Robotics nears $1B in total funding as demand for autonomous heavy equipment surges
researchResults.description:
Bedrock Robotics has secured $600 million to scale autonomous heavy equipment and combat construction labor shortages.

The post Bedrock Robotics nears $1B in total funding as demand for autonomous heavy equipment surges appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Teradyne Robotics partners with Sereact to scale physical AI in retail and logistics
researchResults.description:
Sereact and Teradyne have already shipped hundreds of UR robots in dual-arm systems to live customer sites across Europe.

The post Teradyne Robotics partners with Sereact to scale physical AI in retail and logistics appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Agility and GXO Logistics plan expanded deployment of Digit humanoid
researchResults.description:
GXO Logistics, which has tested humanoid robots from multiple companies, will deploy Agility's Digit at two more sites.

The post Agility and GXO Logistics plan expanded deployment of Digit humanoid appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Eka Robotics raises $150M to scale its vision-force-action model for robots
researchResults.description:
Eka Robotics is building a vision-force-action, or VFA, model to develop an intuition of physics through reinforcement learning at scale.

The post Eka Robotics raises $150M to scale its vision-force-action model for robots appeared first on The Robot Report.

researchResults.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
researchResults.description: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown 14-fold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

researchResults.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
researchResults.description: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

researchResults.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
researchResults.description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

researchResults.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
researchResults.description: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.

researchResults.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
researchResults.description: Learn AI literacy via Google’s latest AI Quests lesson on neuroscience, “Polar Peaks.”
